_comment: Mutation testing — StrykerJS 10 on the Vitest leg.
DRIVE THIS WITH `bun scripts/mutation.ts`, not `npx stryker` directly.
The break threshold deliberately does NOT live here: it lives in
scripts/quality-gates.json alongside every other gate number, and the
runner passes it as --thresholds.break. Two copies of a threshold is one
copy too many.
WHY VITEST AND NOT THE BUN POOL: Stryker ships no Bun test runner, and the
backend suite's per-file mock.module() isolation fights perTest coverage
analysis. The Vitest leg is the surface Stryker can actually drive — which
is the path docs/development-lifecycle.md planned. Scope is therefore
web/src/lib/** pure logic; the Bun-tested backend is not mutated.
ignorePatterns: Stryker seeds its sandbox from git, so the GITIGNORED
.svelte-kit/ is left out — and web/tsconfig.json extends
./.svelte-kit/tsconfig.json. Without the un-ignore below every run dies in
dependency optimization with 'Tsconfig not found / Could not resolve
node:module'. Run `bunx svelte-kit sync` before Stryker if it is absent.
The `mutate` list below is a FALLBACK for a bare `npx stryker run`. The
runner always passes an explicit --mutate, because these globs alone are
too wide: they match every web/src/lib/**.ts, including modules the vitest
leg never measures (workflow-yaml.ts is bun-tested, and mutating it here
yielded 62 NoCoverage mutants and a 0% file score). mutation.ts intersects
them with the --coverage.include allowlist in scripts/test-coverage.sh.
THE `related` TRAP — read before changing anything here. Stryker's vitest
runner uses vitest's --related module-graph filter by default, and it
CANNOT follow $lib-ALIASED imports, which is how most tests here import.
It fails per-file and SILENTLY: affected files report every mutant as
NoCoverage, so code whose tests exist and pass scores 0%. Measured: the
first full run saw 157 of 521 test files and scored 66.04% — an artifact,
not a quality signal.
`related: false` fixes discovery but is not affordable: one 99-mutant file
took 18m51s with 93 mutants TIMING OUT, because this suite's per-run
overhead is ~156s against ~34s of actual test time. So `related` stays ON
and scripts/mutation.ts instead FAILS LOUDLY on any file that comes back
100% NoCoverage — the silent artifact becomes a visible scope error.
Stryker's own 'Vitest failed to find test files related to mutated files'
warning is the same signal; never treat it as noise.
vitest.stryker.config.ts (not vitest.config.ts) drops *.server.test.ts,
which cannot resolve $server inside the sandbox. See that file's header.
